verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm one-click prebuilt templates covering PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI ('Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click' and 'PyTorch, vLLM, ComfyUI, agents, and more. Real deployments you can copy'), plus a dedicated templates introduction guide and ability to build custom templates. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of template usage (community evidence covers general reliability/pricing, not templates), and no detail on CUDA-specific template variety.
